purpose: Explicit ledger of skill identities found during enumeration that are not promoted to canonical records because Xenoverse 2-specific class/subcategory evidence is insufficient or conflicting.
rules: Do not invent class/subcategory, Ki cost, acquisition, DLC, CaC availability, or Ultimate Finish requirements.
A gap may be promoted only after Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes the required field(s).
Historical or cross-game evidence is retained as corroboration, not treated as current Xenoverse 2 proof.

gaps.name: Acid
gaps.known_identity: Cast-exclusive Super used by Saibaman variants
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns Acid ID 140, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Saibaman; it separately lists raid-boss Acid as ID 143.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact lists Acid at IDs 140 and 143 under Super Skills.
The Xenoverse 2 Saibaman page lists Acid on Saibaman 2.
A dated Xenoverse 2 community discussion identifies Acid in the Saibaman 2 raid moveset.

2026-09-24 refresh: the Xenoverse 2 Character ID List and Skills Guide independently distinguish normal Acid ID 140 from raid Acid ID 143, while the Saibaman page confirms Acid in the Saibaman 2 moveset.

2026-09-24 follow-up: a maintained Xenoverse 2 unobtainable-skills list explicitly includes Acid, and an independent Xenoverse 2 move-list reference identifies Acid as a Super Attack on Saibaman variants; both strengthen the existing CaC-unavailable/Super boundary.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence continues to establish Acid as a CaC-unavailable Super Skill, with normal ID 140 distinct from raid-boss ID 143. Independent current-indexed references additionally confirm its Super Attack placement and unobtainable-by-CaC boundary. The only canonical field still missing is numeric Ki cost; no cost is inferred.

Saiyan Survivors lists Howl on Great Ape Nappa and Vegeta.
Power x10 x2? Great Ape Transformation lists Howl on Great Ape Nappa and Vegeta.

2026-09-24 evidence refresh: Great Ape Festival, The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest!, Saiyan Survivors, Power x10 x2? Great Ape Transformation, Expert Mission 3 — Assault of the Great Ape, and Legend Patrol's Power x10! Vegeta Transforms independently expose Howl in Great Ape movesets; Legend Patrol explicitly labels it an Evasive Skill.
gaps.reason: Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes Howl as a CaC-unavailable Evasive Skill used by Great Ape enemies across PQs, Expert Mission 3, and Legend Patrol/story content. The dedicated 2026-09-24 evidence refresh strengthens the recurring NPC boundary. Numeric Ki cost remains unverified and is not inferred.
